title: Notepad Save As
task: Open Notepad, type "OpenUse test file", and save it as openuse-test.txt on my Desktop.
expectedOutcome: Notepad saves the requested text as openuse-test.txt on the user's Desktop and the saved state is verified through UI state.
criteria: The native Save As dialog is inspected after it appears.
The filename and Desktop location are selected through OpenUse tools.
The saved state is verified through UI state; no arbitrary filesystem tool is introduced.
